tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Events in Amsterdam on one day, from the Essentially Amsterdam What's On calendar (today and the next six days). Returns up to 10 events, best first, each with title, time, venue and a link to its row on our calendar page.

tools.name: jobs
tools.description: Search current English-language job openings in the Amsterdam area from the Essentially Amsterdam job board. Returns up to 10 of the newest matching roles with title, company, area and salary when the employer publishes one, each linking to the job on our job board.

tools.name: directory_search
tools.description: Search owner-verified local businesses in the Essentially Amsterdam directory by name, type or area. Returns up to 10 listings with name, category, area and a link to the listing page.

tools.name: markets_today
tools.description: Street and food markets in Amsterdam open on a given day (default today), with opening hours where known and a link to our market guide.

tools.name: conferences
tools.description: Upcoming conferences in Amsterdam from the Essentially Amsterdam conference calendar, each date checked against the conference's own page. Filter by month and field. Returns up to 10, soonest first, with dates, venue, field, a link to our conferences page and the conference's own website.

tools.name: guide_search

tools.name: recent_news
tools.description: The newest Amsterdam news articles published on essentiallyamsterdam.com, newest first, optionally only those matching a keyword. Returns up to 10 with headline, date, a one-line summary and the link. The reply also gives the date of the newest post on the site.

tools.name: net_salary
tools.description: Gross to net pay in the Netherlands for 2026 (Belastingdienst tables), with or without the 30% ruling: exactly the answer of our net salary calculator page. Returns net per month (holiday allowance spread over 12 months), net per year and the tax breakdown, with a link to the calculator.
